Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.label: D'thorga Framework
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.description: The shared library every D'thorga mod builds on. On its own it changes little you will notice: it knows what each colonist is breathing, lets fires fill roofed rooms with smoke, and puts idle machines, and lights in empty rooms, on standby to save power.
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.otherMods: Where RimThunder or Vanilla Vehicles Expanded makes a part, our vehicles and buildings ask for theirs instead of ours (Parts for building). It also keeps the game's log going after its 10,000-message limit, for every mod.
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.moreSettings: More in Options > Mod settings > D'thorga Framework.
